source: ⛔ SAMPLE for the invented client `acme`. The numbers are the template's; they were not measured on any account. Never quote a real client from this file: copy clients/costs._TEMPLATE.json into your own client folder and follow scripts/refresh_costs.md.

plan._credit_price_usd: 0 = unset, and the estimator prints credits only. Derive yours from your invoice: monthly price ÷ monthly credits.

_default_preset: Both quoting tools price QUALITY unless you pass --economy (the quality floor, SKILL.md §4 item 11); economy is a labelled comparison only (v2.62.0).

economy.note: Copied from clients/costs._TEMPLATE.json so the sample runs. ⛔ DERIVE your own, do not copy: `python3 scripts/rate_card.py lookup --model <m> --res <r> --seconds <n>`.

quality.note: Copied from clients/costs._TEMPLATE.json so the sample runs. ⛔ DERIVE your own, do not copy.

_last_verified: Empty on purpose: nobody measured these numbers, so the estimator says the estimate is ASSUMED.
_provenance: SAMPLE. Not measured. The preset numbers are the template's.
